Gulshan Kumar and T-Series presents Bhushan Kumar's "Gajanan ". This song is sung by Sachet Tandon, and the music is composed by Shabbir Ahmed & Penned by Shabbir Ahmed, Shamim Ahmed Shaikh, Ankita Raj.
Get ready to welcome Bappa On this auspicious occasion of Ganesh Chaturthi, it's time to welcome Lord Ganesh in Bollywood style. Get ready to welcome Bappa with the song "Gajanan".
Stream the Full Song Here

Song: Gajanan
Singer: Sachet Tandon
Music: Shabbir Ahmed
Lyrics: Shabbir Ahmed, Shamim Ahmed Shaikh, Ankita Raj
